summary: Still too early to judge the agent layers: only one day of ideas (Oct 15, 24 ideas) has settled, and that day was carded before the catalyst and macro agents started, so news, red flags, earnings and macro-brief risk have no forward results yet. The macro-fit backtest again points the wrong way: recent macro tailwinds came before WORSE setup results than headwinds, so it stays information only. The Top 2 scoreboard is off to a weak start (9 closed picks, avg -1.7% with stops vs +1.4% for the average candidate), but 9 trades is far too few to conclude anything. No ranking changes proposed.
findings: Macro fit (backtest, 6,326 signals Apr 2025-Oct 2026): 5-day tailwind +0.59% (n 1,026) vs headwind +1.99% (n 804), t -1.67, halves -1.1% / -1.1%. Same sign both halves but t 2 - NOT PASSED, info only.
Macro fit 20-day: tailwind +1.38% vs headwind +0.95%, t -0.81, halves -0.9% / -0.1% - not passed. By setup only Round Number Magnet reaches t -2.05 (tailwind worse); not a layer test.
Forward log: 152 ideas carded Oct 15-23 over 7 dates; 24 settled, all from Oct 15 (1 date). Settled ideas +0.2% vs SPY on average (SPY -1.7% that week).
Catalyst, red flags, earnings-in-hold, macro-brief risk: 0 checked rows settled (Oct 15 cards predate the agents) - no evidence yet. First agent-researched rows (Oct 16 cards) settle next week.
More supporting layers (n 3) -0.8% vs fewer (n 9) +5.5% abs; macro tailwind n 10 -1.3%. Single date, far too thin to read.
By role (Oct 15 only): candidates +1.0% vs SPY (n 19), pick1 OSCR -5.4%, pick2 SN +3.1%, watch -4.0% (n 3).
Top 2 scoreboard: 9 closed picks Oct 9-15, 3 winners, avg -1.70% with stops (5 of 9 stopped), -0.70% without stops, vs avg candidate +1.45%. 1 no-fill (ABCL). Too few to judge.

Setup review flag is ON: follow-through Oct 22 (post-thrust playbook: Rotation Rookie +0.34R, Leader Pullback +0.29R, Round Number +0.29R), breadth Weak 3+ sessions, 3 of top 5 themes new since Oct 11.
proposals: No layer changes yet: not enough data. Macro fit did not pass (t -1.67); agent layers have 0 settled checked rows. Revisit when the log has ~60 settled ideas over ~20 dates (around late Nov).
Keep macro fit as information only. Optional research (not a ranking change): test whether a macro HEADWIND is a mean-reversion plus; it is negative in both halves but t -1.67, so it is not proven.

Watch the stop rule: 5 of 9 picks stopped out and the no-stop result (-0.7%) beat the stopped result (-1.7%). Too few trades to change anything; re-check at 30+ closed picks (the replay in trade_bt.pick_replay can test it now if Adam wants).

Act on the existing setup review flag (say 'review my trade setups'): post-thrust playbook after the Oct 22 follow-through, plus Weak breadth and theme rotation since the Oct 11 baseline. Any change needs Adam's approval.
